shapeSummary: Black rectangular sensor body (34 x 14 x 13.5 mm) with two thin end mounting tabs on the back plane, each with a 3.2 mm through hole along Z. A small connector block projects from the top long edge, bringing total Y extent to 18.9 mm. Two shallow round lens recesses are cut in the front face. Overall envelope is 44.5 x 18.9 x 13.5 mm, centered in X and Z with the bottom at Y=0.
warnings: Dimensions are unverified and come from the spec sheet and photo proportions.
Hole diameter (3.2 mm), spacing (37 mm) and Y position are estimates. Hole Y was set to 3.75 so the tab stays within Y>=0.
Body length (34 mm), tab thickness (3 mm) and the connector block size and position are approximated.
Lens recesses are simplified round pockets; the real sensor has a stepped rectangular emitter housing, which is omitted.
The connector is a plain block with no pin cavity, and the PCB is not modeled.
The Y axis is treated as the 18.9 mm width, following the analysis axes, so the part is not oriented as it would sit on a table.
cadquery:
body = cq.Workplane('XY').box(34, 14, 13.5, centered=(True, False, True))
bridge = cq.Workplane('XY').box(37, 7.5, 3, centered=(True, False, False)).translate((0, 0, -6.75))
tabs = (cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-6.75)
        .pushPoints([(-18.5, 3.75), (18.5, 3.75)]).circle(3.75).extrude(3))
conn = cq.Workplane('XY').box(10, 4.9, 6, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((0, 14, 0))
part = body.union(bridge).union(tabs).union(conn)
holes = (cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-8)
         .pushPoints([(-18.5, 3.75), (18.5, 3.75)]).circle(1.6).extrude(6))
part = part.cut(holes)
lens = (cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=3.75)
        .pushPoints([(-9, 7), (9, 7)]).circle(2.5).extrude(3.5))
part = part.cut(lens)
